title: Document the sync sign-off request and the separate reviewer
notes: UPSTREAM-SYNC.md now matches the merge workflow: the sync agent posts Sync sign-off requested and never posts Sync review comments. A separate read-only reviewer posts Sync review: FINAL ACCEPT or Sync review: not accepted. The workflow merges only a yojen7 FINAL ACCEPT at a 40-character sha. AGENTS.md no longer says the sync agent merges those PRs.
